:::{#cor-self-outer-product-rank}
#### A nonzero self outer product has rank one

If $\vx$ is a nonzero vector,
then the [self outer product](#def-self-outer-product) $\soprod{\vx}$
has [rank](linear-algebra.qmd#def-rank) one:

$$
\rankf{\soprod{\vx}} = 1
$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\rankf{\soprod{\vx}}
&= \rankf{\oprod{\vx}{\vx}}
&& \text{(definition of the self outer product)}
\\
&= 1
&& \text{(@thm-outer-product-rank, with } \vecf{u} = \vecf{v} = \vx \neq \vzero \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
